versions.changelog:
Initial release of Baby Words Tracker

- Enables easy recording of baby’s spoken words and phrases in multiple languages, with support for bracket notation for partially spoken words.
- Automatically classifies new vocabulary as single, double, triple-character words, or full sentences.
- Avoids duplicate entries and generates real-time vocabulary statistics and growth reports.
- Supports Mandarin, Cantonese, English, and more.
- Syncs all records and reports to Feishu cloud documents for easy access by parents.
